headline: Ten new tricks for your notch

features.title: Updates in the Notch
features.text: DynaNotch now tells you when a new version is out. Click Update in the panel and it installs itself, then shows you what's new.

features.title: Copy Progress
features.text: The pill fills up green while Finder copies files, so you can see how far a big copy has got.

features.title: Smart Copy
features.text: Copy an amount, a unit, a time or a colour and the notch converts it. Click the result to copy it.

features.title: Agent Island
features.text: Claude Code asks for permission in the notch: Allow, Deny or jump to the Terminal, without switching windows.

features.title: Drop Alchemy
features.text: Drop images on the shelf zones to cut out the subject, read the text, shrink them or convert to PNG or JPEG.

features.title: Camera Guard+
features.text: The microphone popup names the app that is listening, a dot stays while it does, and a log keeps the history.

features.title: Meeting Meter
features.text: A call timer starts once your mic has been on for 15 seconds, with a short recap when the call ends.

features.title: Focus Guard & Soundscapes
features.text: Open a distracting app during focus time and the island shakes. Rain, brown noise or a fireplace play with your Pomodoro.

features.title: Mac Vitals
features.text: A heads-up when your Mac runs hot, memory is tight, the disk is nearly full or an app runs away with the CPU.

features.title: Daily Wrap
features.text: At the end of the day, one card with your screen time, focus sessions, songs and commits.

features.title: Voice Notes
features.text: Speak a note, a reminder or a timer. Recognition runs on your Mac, so your voice never leaves it.

features.title: Lock Screen
features.text: Weather and battery widgets on the lock screen, lock and unlock sounds and an Unlocked popup.

features.title: Every Display
features.text: Show the island on every display or let it follow the mouse; pill width and height sliders.

features.title: Calendar & Quick Settings
features.text: Calendar and Quick Settings tabs, a Home card grid with world clocks, network, sunrise and sunset.

features.title: Command Palette
features.text: ⌃⌥K opens the palette; record your own shortcuts and trigger actions by knocking a modifier key.

features.title: Timers & Alarms
features.text: Repeat timers, ringing alarms, Pomodoro stats and alert sounds per category.

features.title: Now Playing
features.text: Synced lyrics, listening history with bookmarks, and media keys that always drive the current player.

features.title: Clipboard & Shelf
features.text: Clipboard history, a file shelf, screenshots to the shelf and an install offer for disk images.

features.title: Settings
features.text: A searchable settings window, material presets, translucency, export and import.
